title: Static-site generator: render lessons + embed in-browser runner (accessible, WCAG-AA aim)
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). The learner site is the primary delivery mechanism that turns the schema-valid corpus into something a beginner can actually use. It must be accessible (WCAG-AA), render every valid lesson, embed the in-browser runner for zero-install exercises, and fail the build if any exercise has solutionVerified:false. Gated on Gate G1 (≥ 1 partner verbally committed) and the SSG choice from occ-spike-007.
objective: Build the static site using the SSG chosen in occ-spike-007, rendering all schema-valid lessons with embedded in-browser Pyodide runner, passing WCAG-AA accessibility checks, and failing the build on any invalid or unverified exercise.
acceptanceCriteria: Every schema-valid lesson is rendered into the static site; build fails if any lesson is schema-invalid.
Build fails if any exercise has solutionVerified:false or is missing a test suite.
The in-browser runner is embedded in each lesson page so examples run and exercises grade in-page; no server-side code execution.
Accessibility checks pass for both prose and the runner/editor: keyboard navigation, correct focus order, alt text on images, sufficient color contrast — WCAG-AA target.
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass.
output: A merged PR adding the complete SSG-based static site that renders all lessons, embeds the in-browser runner, passes accessibility checks, and gates the build on solutionVerified.
